answer: Map the attestation graph like an atlas: honest agents form a dense, well-linked continent, while a sybil ring attaches through a thin bottleneck of few real edges. Measure each account graph conductance — a cluster hiding behind a sparse cut earns a penalty that ripples outward to every identity it vouches for. To shine as a genuine pearl in the honest sea, an attacker must forge many non-kin attestation edges, each demanding real audited work, so cost scales with edges not with cheap minted accounts.
